title: Mailbox Intent Schema v1
description: OpenYggdrasil mailbox intent ticket schema. It describes product-shaped save, query, and prune intents without embedding worker verdicts or proof claims.

intent.description: Intent type. save asks whether bounded source material should become durable memory. query asks for source-backed recall. prune asks for lifecycle cleanup.

mail_id.description: Stable mailbox item id. Recommended shape is provider-prefix, timestamp, and random suffix.

provider_id.description: Provider that emitted the intent, such as hermes, claude-code, or codex.

context_snapshot.description: Bounded user-facing context. For save intents this is the candidate source span; for query intents this is the user question or recall need.

query_text.description: Recall query text for query intents.

topic_hint.description: Optional topic hint for routing. It is not a storage verdict.

_affordance.description: Provider-facing emission guidance. This is an affordance contract, not a worker decision.

when_to_emit.description: Condition under which the provider may emit this mailbox intent.

do_not_emit_when.description: Condition under which the provider must not emit this mailbox intent.

if_unsure.description: Fallback behavior when the provider is unsure.

_operator_hint.description: Optional role routing hint. The receiving worker still owns mailbox-first judgment.

_execution_policy.description: Execution policy hint. It must not override worker-owned validation or source checks.

if_wrong.description: Recovery guidance if the intent is routed incorrectly.
